tools.description: Modern age encryption key generator with secure defaults and SSH key support
tools.usage: age-keygen -o key.txt # Generate new keypair\nage-keygen -y key.txt # Extract public key\nage-keygen | tee key.txt | age-keygen -y > pub.txt # Generate and split keys

tools.description: Simple, modern, and secure file encryption tool with public key cryptography
tools.usage:
age -r pubkey.txt file.txt > file.txt.age # Encrypt with public key
age -d -i key.txt file.txt.age > file.txt # Decrypt with private key
age -p file.txt > file.txt.age # Encrypt with passphrase
echo 'secret' | age -r pubkey.txt -a # Encrypt and armor
